events.lead: Weddings and banquets framed by Lake St. Moritz and the Engadin peaks — each one planned individually with our family, from the first aperitif to the last dram in Devil’s Place.
events.title: Celebrate with the lake as your witness
hero.caption: The Restaurant
hero.lead: Honest, home-style cooking — the classics done properly, and a new five-course menu every evening.
menu.sample: A sample menu — our chef changes it daily.
menu.title: Five-course menu
meta.description: Home-style cooking on Lake St. Moritz: Châteaubriand, fondues and a daily five-course menu. Lake View Lounge, Terrace and private Stübli for celebrations.
meta.title: Restaurant, Lounge & Terrace
restaurant.p1: Our kitchen is proudly home-style: a classic Châteaubriand from the grill with homemade Sauce Béarnaise, a generous choice of fondues, and changing dishes from the chef.
restaurant.p2: Since 2019 a wider window front brings the lake right to your table. Hotel guests enjoy a five-course dinner daily (four courses in the off-season) — and the same menu is open to visitors.
restaurant.title: Classics, done properly
stubli.lead: Two intimate, wood-panelled Stübli — ideal for a family dinner, a birthday, a fondue with friends, or a focused seminar away from the office.
venues.lead: Where the day slows down — and the evening begins.
venues.lounge.text: By day: coffee, afternoon tea and sweet treats. By evening, a relaxed meeting place for cocktails as the lights come on across the water.
venues.lounge.title: Lake View Lounge
venues.terrace.text: Sun, lake and mountain air. Lunch, a glass of Swiss white, or simply an hour doing nothing at all.
venues.terrace.title: The Waldhaus Terrace
venues.title: Lounge & Terrace
